svg.aria-label: Practice 04: Graph the path you know. Loop the one you do not. A graph is fixed nodes and edges: same input, same path, and when it breaks you know which node broke. A loop is the model choosing its next action until it decides it is done: flexible, and prone to wandering.

text.tspan: Loop the one you do not.
